component.name: Chat+ Desktop
component.summary: Use Synology ChatPlus and Synology Chat with multiple accounts

description.p: Chat+ Desktop is an independent messaging client built with Rust and Tauri. Keep separate accounts signed in, receive native notifications and choose Light, Dark or Retro appearance.

Synology ChatPlus and Synology Chat are the primary supported integrations. Discord, WhatsApp, Messenger, Mattermost and Slack have experimental web integrations. Available notification and unread features vary by service.
